description: • Pennsylvania's divided state government is at stake in the upcoming midterm elections as Democrats aim to win the state Senate. • Control of the state legislature will determine the fate of key policy issues like minimum wage, marijuana legalization, and abortion access. • A party trifecta, where one party controls the governor's office and both legislative chambers, has been rare in recent Pennsylvania history.
